▤ OFFICIAL POOL GUIDELINES

6/49 Bingo Pool Rules & Timeline

Review registration cutoff, the eight draws, entry requirements and winner distribution.

First drawDecember 2, 2026
Ticket & number cutoffDecember 2 · 10 p.m.Toronto time
Card price$20
Final draw · pool end dateDecember 26, 2026

01Supporting the Team

This fundraiser supports Mississauga Lady Jays U13 Select. Choose the player you support when requesting a card. Their totals show confirmed ticket sales.

02How to Enter

Each card costs $20. Request one or more tickets, pay the order total by e-transfer, then select six distinct numbers on each ticket from 1–49 after the organizer confirms payment.

03The 8 Draws

Eight designated official Lotto 6/49 draws count, every Wednesday and Saturday from December 2 through December 26, 2026. Use only six main numbers, excluding bonus numbers and other prize features.

04How Bingo Works

Matches accumulate. Each selected number counts once and remains matched across the pool. Numbers need not all appear in the same draw.

05Winning the Pool

After Draw 8, cards with 6/6 matches win. If none reaches 6/6, the highest cumulative match count wins. An early 6/6 does not end this pool.

06Ties

Split the winner’s pot equally among tied winning cards at the end of the pool.

07The 50/50 Pot

Half of collected paid entry fees goes to winners; half supports the team. For $1,000 collected, each share is $500. The displayed total pot is gross paid entry fees.

08Registration & Payment

Ticket requests, payment confirmation and number selection must be completed by 10:00 p.m. December 2, 2026, Toronto time. Use your card reference in the e-transfer message. An entry is complete only after payment confirmation and number selection. Check your details carefully.

09Numbers Cannot Be Changed

On this website, numbers lock immediately upon confirmation. They stay fixed throughout the pool.

10Official Results

The organizer enters verified official draw numbers. The website updates matches, rankings and totals automatically, refreshing every 30 seconds. Results are not imported automatically.

11Final Winner Verification

Before payout, the organizer checks registration, payment, selected numbers, official results, final matches and tied cards.

12Fundraiser Administration

Organizers may correct recording errors. This fundraiser is separate from the official Lotto 6/49 lottery.

13Winner Payment

The organizer contacts verified winners through their account email to arrange e-transfer payment.

14Social Media

Team social channels may promote the fundraiser and share draw updates. Ask winners for permission before posting names or photos. Private contact and payment details are not published.

15Age Verification

Participants must be at least 18. Organizers verify eligibility before confirming an entry; the website does not verify age automatically.

Multi-ticket orders update

Run this update once in your existing Supabase project to enable quantities and order payment confirmation. It preserves existing tickets, payments and chosen numbers.

Team player list update

Download this update and run it in a new Supabase SQL Editor query to replace placeholder labels with your confirmed roster and General Support. Existing cards supporting Sofia, Maddy, Talia or Cindy retain their links. The update stops if any placeholder already has cards, so those can be reviewed first.

Permanent ticket numbers

For your existing project: download this update, paste it into a new Supabase SQL Editor query, and Run. It assigns a unique permanent number to every existing and future card. Existing cards keep their payment references, owners, numbers and payment status. Gaps in ticket numbering are normal if cards are removed.

Registered-participant counter update

For an existing project: download this small update, paste it into a new Supabase SQL Editor query, and Run once. It adds an aggregate participant count without exposing account identities. It does not change cards or payments. Until installed, the counter displays a dash.

Connect your shared database

This file includes the website and downloadable database setup. It stays closed until you configure your own project. No demo records are imported.

  1. Create a project at supabase.com.
  2. Download the SQL below, paste it into the project's SQL Editor, and run it once in a new project.
  3. In this HTML file, fill in https://ngkloedyqxthlpjwliui.supabase.co and sb_publishable_gZeIAuHPIQfYYLESXktghw_63Kkm4y_ near the start of the application script. Use the publishable or legacy anon key only; never a secret or service-role key.
  4. In Authentication → URL Configuration, set your GitHub Pages address as the Site URL and an allowed redirect URL. Enable email/password sign-in and email confirmation.
  5. Upload this HTML as index.html to your existing GitHub repository. Create and verify your own participant account.
  6. In SQL Editor, run the final commented organizer INSERT with your account email substituted. Then sign out and back in to see Organizer.
  7. Enter the e-transfer email, player names, and cutoff. Test with two separate accounts/devices: request → confirm payment → choose numbers → check the public leaderboard. Test that a participant cannot confirm payments or edit draws.

Opening entries requires your approved fundraiser rules, including prizes, ties, entry eligibility, cancellation/refunds and privacy details. These are not supplied by this software.

Official draw importing is not connected. The organizer records results manually; scores and shared displays update automatically. Account recovery and production email delivery should also be configured before launch.
